sources.title: CBC News — mayor and councillor pay survey, 2021
sources.locator: Eight CBC table blocks of 20 municipalities; visible table-page labels 1, 2, 4 and 8; other blocks identified by municipality range
notes: CBC reports municipal office pay from 2021 financial disclosures and municipal staff responses. Councillor values represent the most common payment in the municipality, not a named individual.

The table labels its figures base pay and excludes additional allowances and regional board stipends, but Vancouver values match actual remuneration including extra duties, so the dataset uses reported-office-pay.
Port Hardy explicitly uses 2020 because of municipal staffing issues; its two observations are assigned year 2020.
Extracted from the search-indexed official Creston attachment; direct PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403. No original-file hash or direct visual inspection is claimed.
